name: Octonauts
description: Follows an underwater exploring crew made up of stylized anthropomorphic animals, a team of eight adventurers who live in an undersea base, the Octopod, from where they go on undersea adventures with the help of a fleet of aquatic vehicles.

videos.title: The Great Penguin Race
videos.overview: The Octonauts cheer Peso on as he goes home to compete against an awesomely athletic penguin in an annual tournament: the Iron Clam Competition.

videos.title: The Great Christmas Rescue
videos.overview: The Octonauts travel to Professor Inkling's childhood home for Christmas, an undersea mountain. But they discover that a rockslide has endangered the local creatures - including a rare species of golden coral, and Inkling's little octopus nephew, Squirt! With the help of Tweak's latest invention, the Gup X, the Octonauts must rescue the creatures and save Christmas.

videos.title: The Amazon Adventure
videos.overview: In this special episode, the Octonauts travel deep down the Amazon river in search of a lost city - and Kwazii's long lost grandfather, Calico Jack!

videos.title: The Mariana Trench Adventure
videos.overview: Tweak has designed a brand-new Deep Sea Station to study the deepest, darkest reaches of the ocean, but the Octonauts face multiple challenges: from getting it down there, to the extreme environment and strange, prehistoric creatures that greet them once they arrive.

videos.title: The Very Vegimal Christmas
videos.overview: Christmas special of the animated deep sea adventure series. The Vegimals' plans for a Christmas feast aboard the Octopod are interrupted when the Octonauts are all entangled in a gigantic blob of sea snot!

videos.title: The Over Under Adventure
videos.overview: The Octonauts' mission to explore Antarctica becomes a desperate rescue as a group of sea stars and urchins are threatened by a brinicle - a rare underwater icicle that can freeze creatures on the sea bed.

videos.title: The Great Arctic Adventure
videos.overview: Peso goes with Barnacles to help his sister and her new polar cubs learn to navigate the harsh conditions of the frozen arctic.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Great Swamp Search
videos.overview: Tweak and the Octonauts go to The Everglades to visit her dad, Ranger Marsh and help him rescue some non-native creatures before a storm hits. The team's recently built GUP-K is also there to save the day.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Caves of Sac Actun
videos.overview: The Octonauts embarked on an underwater adventure navigating a set of challenging caves to help a small octopus read return home to the Caribbean Sea.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Great Barrier Reef
videos.overview: In this musical special the Octonauts must find a way to hold back hungry swarms of Crown of Thorns starfish to save a new friend's fragile reef home.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Ring of Fire
videos.overview: The Octonauts create a Mantis Shrimp Robot to save the oceanic creatures from a tsunami and volcanic eruptions in the Pacific Ring of Fire.

videos.title: The Undersea Storm
videos.overview: As a huge storm heads towards the headquarters, the Octonaut crew hurriedly goes into preparation. However, Kwaji, who went out to test drive the expedition ship, is unable to return to Octopold because he is rescuing the animals.

videos.title: The Giant Squid
videos.overview: The Octonauts roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Whether it's a perilous voyage to the bottom of the sea or the piratey pursuit of a giant squid, the Octonauts leap into action and always prove that eight heads are better than one! The Octonauts set out to find and photograph Inkling's long lost cousin, the elusive Giant Squid.

videos.title: The Great Algae Escape
videos.overview: Captain Barnacles and his crew must catch a runaway Octopod, when it is hijacked by a group of crustaceans trying to escape their algae-infested waters.

videos.title: The Walrus Chief
videos.overview: When Peso's precious medical kit is taken, Barnacles and Kwazii sneak into a dangerous walrus colony to get it back, disguised as a walrus.

videos.title: The Flying Fish
videos.overview: When a school of flying fish accidentally make off with a rare book belonging to Professor Inkling, the Octonauts rig up the Gup B to fly after them and get it back.

videos.title: The Narwhal
videos.overview: While exploring the Arctic, the Octopod gets trapped in the ice. Only Barnacles's skillful navigation, and the help of a friendly Narwhal, can get them free.

videos.title: The Monster Map
videos.overview: The Octonauts follow an old map to what Kwazii believes is treasure guarded by a sea monster but, instead, they meet a playful Octopus with all kinds of surprising abilities.

videos.title: The Crab and the Urchin
videos.overview: The crew pursues crustaceans who’ve hijacked the Octopod.

videos.title: The Albino Humpback Whale
videos.overview: The Octonauts help out an Albino Humpback Whale with a nasty sunburn.

videos.title: The Remipedes
videos.overview: When Shellington gets lost in a dark sea cave, he gets unexpected assistance from some blind Remipedes.

videos.title: The Orcas
videos.overview: When a huge Orca whale becomes stranded on a beach, Captain Barnacles Bear and the Octonauts devise a plan to pull him back into the water, with some help from a group of tunnelling Fiddler Crabs.

videos.title: The Blobfish Brothers
videos.overview: The Octonauts must evacuate sea creatures before an underwater volcano erupts, but there's one creature that won't budge: a slow moving, gelatinous Blobfish.

videos.title: The Decorator Crab
videos.overview: When important objects go missing from their ship, the Octonauts stake out the thief, who turns out to be a decorator crab stealing their things to decorate his shell.

videos.title: The Whale Shark
videos.overview: When Kwazii's Gup-B breaks down in a storm, not even brave Captain Barnacles can save him alone. Fortunately, a chain of reef lobsters lends a hand - and some claws.

videos.title: The Cookiecutter Sharks
videos.overview: Some mysterious holes that keep appearing in the Octonauts' equipment turn out to be the work of cookiecutter sharks whose bioluminescence initially made them invisible against the light coming down from the sea surface.

videos.title: The Jellyfish Bloom
videos.overview: When Shellington gets trapped in the middle of a massive Jellyfish bloom, it's up to the Octonauts to rescue him.

videos.title: The Speedy Sailfish
videos.overview: When all the Gups go out of control, Barnacles and Kwazii leap onto the backs of some speedy Sailfish to round them up.

videos.title: The Vampire Squid
videos.overview: Peso must gather all his courage when he travels deep down to the very bottom of the ocean, the Midnight Zone, and encounters the mysterious Vampire Squid.

videos.title: The Humuhumunukunukuapua'a
videos.overview: When the Octopod's waterworks are flooded with frightened Humuhumu fish, the Octonauts have to find a way to flush them out.

videos.title: The Giant Spider Crab
videos.overview: The octonauts help a 100 year old spider crab which has got its leg trapped in a giant clam whilst en route to its own 100th birthday party. It turns out that Kwazii's afraid of spiders, but he still helps, even though he thought it was a real spider at first.

videos.title: The Giant Kelp Forest
videos.overview: When Kwazii's favorite sub, the Gup B, goes missing, the Octonauts journey into a mysterious kelp forest to find it, meeting strange and interesting creatures along the way.

videos.title: The Hermit Crabs
videos.overview: When Captain Barnacles Bear and most of the crew are unable to return to base, it's up to Peso and Tweak to remove a stuck hermit crab from its shell.

videos.title: The Hungry Pilot Fish
videos.overview: The Octonauts are chased by a whitetip shark only to discover all it really needed was a pilot fish to clean its teeth, and it just so happens that they have just met a lonely pilot fish that is hungry for action.

videos.title: The Beluga Whales
videos.overview: The Octonauts lead a pod of Beluga Whales stuck under the pack ice to safety by getting them to follow Peso while he's playing the same tune as the Beluga's song on his xylophone.

videos.title: The Snot Sea Cucumber
videos.overview: After an underwater tremor, an injured sea cucumber named Slippy gets loose on the Octopod, so to let her breathe, they flood the ship!

videos.title: The Giant Whirlpool
videos.overview: The Octonauts race against time to rescue Tweak's pal, a leatherback sea turtle who's caught in a fast-moving ocean current that's sucking it into a whirlpool.

videos.title: The Slime Eels
videos.overview: Kwazii covets the treasure in a sunken pirate ship, but its protected by slime squirting Slime Eels.

videos.title: The Arctic Orcas
videos.overview: When Captain Barnacles and Peso get lost in the icy Arctic sea, a pod of Orcas help the Octonauts find them.

videos.title: The Lost Sea Star
videos.overview: When the Octonauts find an unusual Sea Star on the beach, they search the ocean from top to bottom (literally) to help find its home.

videos.title: The Giant Jelly
videos.overview: The Octonauts must rescue Peso when he gets trapped inside a giant ctenophore.

videos.title: The Snapping Shrimp
videos.overview: The Octonauts encounter a snapping shrimp – a small creature that uses its claws to make a big, and stunning, noise.

videos.title: The Kelp Forest Rescue
videos.overview: When Peso's little brother, Pinto, comes to visit, he's more interested in being a pirate than a medic – at least until he accompanies Peso on a mission to rescue Dashi and Shellington in a kelp forest.

videos.title: The Enormous Elephant Seal
videos.overview: When Peso and the Octonauts aid an enormous Elephant Seal, he overstays his welcome in the Octopod.

videos.title: The Sardine School
videos.overview: The Octonauts must work together as a team to help a lost sardine find her school.

videos.title: The Eel Ordeal
videos.overview: The Octonauts travel up a treacherous river to help a young migrating eel on her difficult journey.

videos.title: The Dolphin Reef Rescue
videos.overview: When the Octonauts all pitch in to help save a sick coral reef, they get some unexpected help from a pod of playful dolphins.

videos.title: The Pirate Parrotfish
videos.overview: When the Octonauts go on a pirate treasure hunt, Kwazii meets a Parrotfish.

videos.title: The Electric Torpedo Rays
videos.overview: Some electric torpedo rays give the Octopod a jump-start when its batteries go flat during a trip to see Tweak's pal, Sandy the leatherback sea turtle.

videos.title: The Midnight Zone
videos.overview: While exploring the deepest part of the ocean, the Midnight Zone, the Octonauts discover a strange rock that happens to be home to a new species of worm.

videos.title: The Mixed-Up Whales
videos.overview: When the Octonauts clean and repair their ship, the Octopod, the resulting noise causes a nearby blue whale to act in strange and dangerous ways.

videos.title: The Seahorse Tale
videos.overview: After a storm, the Octonauts help a female seahorse search for her missing mate. She tells them, to Kwazii's surprise, that the missing male seahorse is about to give birth to baby seahorses!

videos.title: The Enemy Anemones
videos.overview: The Octonauts land on an island for a picnic but must first help some crabs trapped between two warring groups of aggregate anemones. Meanwhile back on the Octopod, a horde of out of control puddings are attacking. Peso wins the contest between 2 types of blobs.

videos.title: The Crafty Cuttlefish
videos.overview: Captain Barnacles allows Tunip to use his Octo-compass. But when Tunip loses it, a cuttlefish takes it.

videos.title: The Lost Lemon Shark
videos.overview: The Octonauts have their hands full as they look after a headstrong young Lemon Shark who's hurt his nose and can't find his way home.

videos.title: The Baby Dolphin
videos.overview: When a young dolphin follows Kwazii home, he has to babysit while the other Octonauts search for its mother.

videos.title: The Scary Spookfish
videos.overview: The Octonauts try to pull Peso out of an oceanic trench and get some help from a strange looking creature with a see through head: a Spookfish.

videos.title: The Oarfish
videos.overview: Dashi snaps a picture of what appears to be a sea serpent, but the truth is stranger than fiction when it turns out to be an awesomely long Oarfish.

videos.title: The Combtooth Blenny
videos.overview: When Kwazii and Peso are shipwrecked on a desert island, they encounter a Combtooth Blenny - a fish who walks on land! They enlist him to send an SOS message to the other Octonauts.

videos.title: The Marine Iguanas
videos.overview: The team are preparing for a feast of red seaweed on the Galapagos Islands but a trio of salt-sneezing marine iguanas raid the Octopod and eat it all!

videos.title: The Dwarf Lantern Shark
videos.overview: Down in the darkness of the ocean deep, Peso and the Octonauts must help a tiny, injured Dwarf Lantern Shark.

videos.title: The Colossal Squid
videos.overview: The Octopod is attacked by a colossal squid, who drags the ship down an abyssal trench, forcing Barnacles and Kwazii to make a perilous swim outside to confront the gigantic beast.

videos.title: The Adelie Penguins
videos.overview: While Kwazii and Peso have their hands full babysitting a bunch of Adelie penguin chicks, Captain Barnacles must rescue the chicks' parents from a perilous sea storm!

videos.title: The Coconut Crabs
videos.overview: Kwazii finds a mysterious, unbreakable coconut, so the Octonauts seek out the help of some large, island-dwelling coconut crabs to open it.

videos.title: The Great White Shark
videos.overview: Peso must perform an emergency fin bandage on a hungry great white shark, but first they need to subdue the giant predator using a trick called 'tonic immobility'.

videos.title: The Sea Snakes
videos.overview: It's Sea Snakes on an Octopod when a poisonous sea krait lays her eggs in the garden pod, just as Captain Barnacles has to navigate the ship past a treacherous whirlpool.

videos.title: The Bowhead Whales
videos.overview: When the Octonauts are unable to rescue a group of Narwhals trapped behind arctic ice, they recruit a Bowhead Whale to help them break through!

videos.title: The Jawfish
videos.overview: A mouth-brooding jawfish father has lost his eggs, and the Octonauts must brave strong currents and other obstacles to help get them back to him!

videos.title: The Porcupine Puffer
videos.overview: Barnacles, Kwazii and Peso venture back inside a whale shark to retrieve a Porcupine Puffer Fish that was accidentally swallowed.

videos.title: The Damselfish
videos.overview: The Octonauts help a group of algae-eating fish stand up to some aggressive damselfish, who are harming their own reef by over-farming it with algae.

videos.title: The Scared Sperm Whale
videos.overview: A timid sperm whale must help the Octonauts release Peso from a giant clam.

videos.title: The Long Armed Squid
videos.overview: Peso and Kwazii venture down to the midnight zone to help a hurt creature, but what they find is a shipwreck 'haunted' by a spooky-looking long-armed squid.

videos.title: The Fiddler Crabs
videos.overview: The Octonauts help clean up a beach after a storm, but things get complicated when the resident fiddler crabs hijack the Gup-D!

videos.title: The Manta Rays
videos.overview: The Octonauts help a young manta ray find the secret manta ray feeding grounds, but when they finally locate it, the Octonauts become caught in the middle of a dangerous feeding frenzy!

videos.title: The Swashbuckling Swordfish
videos.overview: The octonauts discover a rare showing of a full moon as Kwazii discovers that its known as the Pirate Moon as Kwazii and The Octonauts search for a ship that belonged to the pirate king as Kwazii searches for the sword of the Pirate King until a trio of swordfish prevent Kwazii from getting closer to the wrecked ship.

videos.title: The Triggerfish
videos.overview: The Octonauts' floating temperature sensors alert them to a risk of waterspouts due to a rise in sea surface temperature so they decide to retrieve the devices for safe-keeping. But Kwazii gets into an argument with a possessive triggerfish which has adopted one of the devices as its home, and they both get carried away by a waterspout. Kwazii ends up having to defend the fish from a seabird and a swordfish that want to eat it. Luckily the characteristic grunting sounds that triggerfish make when distressed enables the other Octonauts to locate them.

videos.title: The Mimic Octopus
videos.overview: The Octonauts recruit a shape-shifting mimic octopus to help them recover an important vial of medicinal algae from a moray eel's lair.

videos.title: The Lionfish
videos.overview: The Octonauts get more than they bargained for when they use the Octopod to transport a pair of invasive lionfish back to their native habitat.

videos.title: The Leafy Sea Dragons
videos.overview: When two young leafy sea dragons are accidentally separated from their father and brought onboard the Octopod, the Octonauts must find them before they end up in Kwazii's stew!

videos.title: The Manatees
videos.overview: Running out of air, Barnacles struggles to free his paw from the mouth of a giant clam, while simultaneously directing his crew in a delicate manatee rescue operation.

videos.title: The Saltwater Crocodile
videos.overview: When a gigantic saltwater crocodile wanders into freezing waters, the Octonauts must figure out how to get the predator back to his warm water home - without anyone getting hurt.

videos.title: The Humphead Parrotfish
videos.overview: The Octonauts use magnets to try to stop a meteor that's heading toward the Octopod and get an assist from a rock-chomping humphead parrotfish and her friends.

videos.title: The Gulper Eels
videos.overview: When hungry gulper eels as well as undersea tremors threaten Inkling and Kwazii, Dashi uses the new, multi-purpose Octo Max Suit to rescue them.

videos.title: The Siphonophore
videos.overview: Kwazii and Dashi become entangled in a strange deep-sea creature - a siphonophore.

videos.title: The Water Bears
videos.overview: The gang ventures into a red-hot lava tube to rescue a tiny water bear that does not seem to mind the heat at all.

videos.title: The Cone Snail
videos.overview: Peso sets out to save the day when a cone snail invades the octopod and picks off the crew one by one with its dangerous harpoons.

videos.title: The Artificial Reef
videos.overview: When an underwater storm destroys a small reef, Tweak and her crew try to convert the Gup-F into an artificial equivalent.

videos.title: The Humpback Whales
videos.overview: When a sardine swallows the key to a treasure chest, a humpback whale helps Kwazii track it down.

videos.title: The Pelicans
videos.overview: When a floating garbage patch endangers a flock of pelicans and other sea creatures, the Octonauts and the birds work together to clean it up.

videos.title: The Sea Pigs
videos.overview: The Octonauts must stop a huge herd of sea pigs before they march blindly into the Mariana Trench - where there will be no access to food. But things get chaotic when Tunip goes missing!

videos.title: The Yeti Crab
videos.overview: As Tweak tests the Gup-X deep down in the Midnight Zone, a yeti crab cuts a vital electrical wire in the ship and cuts off all power, endangering itself and the Octonauts.

videos.title: The Barracudas
videos.overview: Shellington and the Vegimals' mission to replant a mangrove forest is put in peril by a school of toothy barracudas.

videos.title: The Duck-Billed Platypus
videos.overview: While rescuing river creatures after a storm, the Octonauts find a strange egg and come under attack by stinging platypuses.

videos.title: The Sea Skaters
videos.overview: When Kwazii gets lost at sea aboard the tiny octo-ski, he meets a flotilla of even tinier sea skaters - the only insects who live on the ocean.

videos.title: The Mudskippers
videos.overview: The Octonauts attempt to keep the peace amongst a trio of mudskippers whose home has been flooded.

videos.title: The Harbour Seal
videos.overview: When Peso's patient, a remora fish, mysteriously disappears, the Octonauts enlist a unique undersea detective - a harbour seal.

videos.title: The Lion's Mane Jellyfish
videos.overview: A lion's mane jellyfish gets its long and stingy tentacles tangled in the bubble engine, unintentionally flooding the Octopod and causing havoc.

videos.title: The Red Rock Crabs
videos.overview: When Shellington and the crew try to gather some skittish crabs who have drifted away from home, they get help from some old friends.

videos.title: The Sea Sponge
videos.overview: A sea sponge that houses other sea creatures in its pores suffers from a mysterious illness and Peso must figure out the cause.

videos.title: The Immortal Jellyfish
videos.overview: Shellington and the Octonauts try to track an unusual creature: a jellyfish that can transform from old to young repeatedly - and live forever!

videos.title: The Urchin Invasion
videos.overview: The Octonauts head to the kelp forest to visit Shellington's sister, Pearl, and her newborn son Periwinkle - only to find the forest endangered by an infestation of kelp-eating urchins!

videos.title: The Hammerhead Sharks
videos.overview: The Octonauts meet some hammerheaded sharks, however, they can't sleep too well because Shellington and Professor Inkling have been arguing about who is smarter that they are no longer friends.

videos.title: The Loggerhead Sea Turtle
videos.overview: After an undersea tremor separates the Gup-X and its crew, Barnacles seeks guidance from a mysterious sea turtle.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Poison Dart Frogs
videos.overview: When a giant wave hurls Amazon River creatures up into the trees, the Octonauts must get them down safely, without disturbing poison dart frogs who live there.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Hidden Lake
videos.overview: The Octonauts are exploring Antarctica, when Shellington discovers strange microscopic creatures living under the ice.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Octopod Mystery
videos.overview: When the Octopod breaks down, Tweak and the crew search for a missing part aboard an abandoned prototype of the ship, not realising something lives there.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Baby Sea Turtles
videos.overview: As newborn baby sea turtles make their way to the ocean, the Octonauts must steer them clear a giant wave and hungry predators.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Walrus Pups
videos.overview: Captain Barnacles and his niece and nephew, Ursa and Orson, must rescue walrus pups who are stranded on a runaway ice floe, before it collides with a huge iceberg!

videos.title: Octonauts and the Mantis Shrimp
videos.overview: The Octonauts must get 2 mantis shrimp to stop fighting before their powerful claw strikes destroy the Octopod.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Loneliest Whale
videos.overview: The Octonauts follow a strange song to a lonely humpback whale.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Tree Lobsters
videos.overview: When a storm washes Peso onto a mysterious, rocky island, he meets a band of lobster-like insects thought to be extinct.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Convict Fish
videos.overview: The Octonauts evacuate the creatures living around a reef before a large archway collapses, but one stubborn convict fish refuses to move from her burrow.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Emperor Penguins
videos.overview: The Octonauts journey across a dangerous expanse of ice to help a penguin mother get back to her family.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Crawfish
videos.overview: When a population of crawfish is stricken by illness, the Octonauts race to find a cure.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Flamingos
videos.overview: The Octonauts find a lost flamingo chick separated from his family and they have to return him there before hungry alligators do!

videos.title: Octonauts and the Tiger Shark
videos.overview: When a hungry tiger shark eats the camera that Tweak's turtle friend Sandy gets in the Octopod, she and the Octonauts must rescue her before it eats everything in its path.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Sunfish
videos.overview: When a huge sunfish enters the GUP-E, Peso and Kwazii must somehow get the large fish out of the Gup. Eventually they find out it's a Sunfish a fish with no fins.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Coelacanth
videos.overview: While exploring a dark and spooky cave, The Octonauts find a strange fossil of a powerful prehistoric fish... but it may be more than just a fossil!

videos.title: Octonauts and the Surfing Snails
videos.overview: When surfing snails are swept out to sea, it's up to Dashi and the Octonauts to save them.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Yellow Bellied Sea Snakes
videos.overview: When Peso gets stranded on a beach with a mass of poisonous snakes after a terrible storm, he and the Octonauts must somehow get them back to the ocean.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Hippos
videos.overview: Trying to return home from a mission along an African river, the Octonauts have trouble getting past a gang of large, mud-splatting, territorial hippos.

videos.title: Octonauts and Operation Cooperation
videos.overview: After Shellington crashes the GUP-D for the 3rd time, he and Kwazii team up with moray eels and grouper fish to help pick up the pieces and fix the vehicle before daylight occurs.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Bomber Worms
videos.overview: While diving down to the Midnight Zone, the Octonauts are attacked by bomber worms.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Kelp Monster Mystery
videos.overview: Dashi teams up with her little sister Koshi to help the Octonauts solve a mysterious disappearance in the Kelp Forest. This is the second episode in which is unknown who sounded the Octo-Alert.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Coconut Crisis
videos.overview: Kwazii takes a vacation on Coconut Island where he gets hit by some coconuts. Then he and the Octonauts must help their old friends the Coconut Crabs discover who's stealing all their coconuts.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Baby Gator
videos.overview: Kwazii adopts a baby alligator naming him Nipper, but when it escapes the Octopod, he and the Octonauts must rescue him.

videos.title: Octonauts and the Spinner Dolphins
videos.overview: The Octonauts struggle to save a pod of spinner dolphins who seem to be just swimming in their sleep.

videos.title: Whales of Mystery
videos.overview: Shellington is excited to find the distinctive tooth of a very rare creature, the spade-toothed beaked whale. Now, the Octonauts must find the tooth’s owner, so Shellington can study it, and so that Peso can help replace its tooth. But it won’t be easy: spade-toothed beaked whales like to be left alone and can dive very deep.

videos.title: Blue Whale Rescue
videos.overview: When Kwazii discovers a blue whale with an injured tail, the Octonauts attempt to use a giant net and Octofloats to keep it from sinking. Meanwhile, Peso and Tweak collaborate on a special brace for its tail, and Kwazii, Dashi and Shellington try to find it enough food. But when the supporting net breaks, the Octonauts have to launch an emergency free-fall rescue!

videos.title: Ghost Ship
videos.overview: The Octonauts follow a trail of deep-sea debris to its source: a derelict ship floating unmanned on the surface. But the ship seems to be haunted by ghostly voices, which a quick dip below the water line reveals to be hundreds of barnacles stuck to the ship. As the ship drifts into waters too cold for the barnacles, the Octonauts must find a way to tow it to warmer waters before it sinks or falls apart.

videos.title: Feeding Frenzy
videos.overview: While exploring a reef, Shellington and Dashi accidentally trigger a feeding frenzy with multiple sharks biting at anything that moves. As Barnacles and Tweak work frantically to plan a rescue, Shellington and Dashi try not to become shark food!

videos.title: Sawfish
videos.overview: When Kwazii gets a case of pirate hiccups, he and Peso go up the river in search of a pirate doctor’s treasure that can cure him.

videos.title: Nautilus
videos.overview: Kwazii sets off on a monster hunt, and soon encounters a shelled creature called a Nautilus.

videos.title: Grey Whales
videos.overview: The Octonauts must help reunite a grey whale calf with his mother, keeping him well fed in the meantime.

videos.title: Flying Squid
videos.overview: The Octonauts meet a flying squid who can help Kwazii's grandfather, Calico Jack, retrieve his treasure.

videos.title: Sea Lions
videos.overview: When a wave traps Dashi in a cave with an injured sea lion, the Octonauts and sea lion pack must work together to save them. Using just some rope and a life buoy the pack fights against the waves to save them. Can they save them before it is too late?

videos.title: Hawksbill Sea Turtle
videos.overview: The Octonauts must guide an ill-stricken hawksbill sea turtle into cooler waters, in order for her to lay healthy eggs.

videos.title: Wood Eating Catfish
videos.overview: When Kwazii is found with an injury, he tells the tale of how he and Calico Jack encountered a fish that ate his peg leg.

videos.title: Seven Sea Squirts
videos.overview: The Octonauts help a band of algae-shooting sea squirts reunite in order to stop an outbreak in the reef.

videos.title: Bullfrogs
videos.overview: When the Vegimals accidentally bring bullfrogs into the Octopod, they must rally them up and bring them back home before the Octonauts find out.

videos.title: Giant Sea Spiders
videos.overview: Kwazii and Shellington get lost in the Antarctic’s deep seas, before meeting a family of giant sea spiders who may know a way out.

videos.title: Great Octo-Bot Rescue
videos.overview: When the Octo-Bots sink into a lake of boiling hot sulfur, Kwazii has to rescue them before the surface hardens.

videos.title: Axolotl
videos.overview: Captain Barnacles and Kwazii help a pair of singing female axolotls named George's mom (yellow) and George (pink) find a new watering hole, while protecting them from a hungry flock of herons.

videos.title: Beavers
videos.overview: In order for a school of salmon to reach their nesting area, the Octonauts must enlist help from a family of beavers.

videos.title: Zombie Worms
videos.overview: The Octolab is being eaten away by a group of zombie worms, tasking the crew with finding a new home for them.

videos.title: Mud Volcanoes
videos.overview: While exploring the Mariana Trench, Shellington and Dashi come across a path full of mud volcanoes and a creature in need.

videos.title: Tiger Fish and Blind Shrimp
videos.overview: The Octonauts encounter a tiger fish and blind shrimp who become separated.

videos.title: Fish Mouth Louse
videos.overview: The Octonauts help a creature find his louse friend who got lost and could be in trouble.

videos.title: Deep Ocean Discovery
videos.overview: Shellington’s sister and nephew, Pearl and Periwinkle, join him on a mission.

videos.title: Silver Sea
videos.overview: The Octonauts encounter a blob of glowing liquid drifting on the ocean’s surface.

videos.title: Bicolour Fangblenny
videos.overview: The crew must catch a mysterious fish that’s out to bite every creature in the reef.

videos.title: Scaly-Foot Snail
videos.overview: The Octonauts meet strong scaly foot snails and enlist them in trying to help save the Octo-Lab from falling into a crevice.

videos.title: Chinese Giant Salamander
videos.overview: The Octonauts head to the Yangtze River to help Min the Mapmaker, an old friend of Inkling's, who's been trapped by a mysterious creature. Turns out, It was just a Chinese giant salamander protecting her precious eggs, which have fallen ill due to rising water temperatures.

videos.title: Bluefin Tuna
videos.overview: After an encounter with a school of migrating tuna, the Octonauts discover that one of the speedy fish, Tina, has been left behind. And she’s injured! Poor Tina has a hook stuck in her mouth and is too weak to swim. After Peso tends to her wound, the Octonauts agree to help get her to the tuna spawning grounds. But they’ll have to be quick: egg-laying season doesn’t last long. Luckily, Tweak’s latest gup, the Gup-R, is the fastest she’s ever built! The Octonauts use it to tow Tina, but when the Gup-R’s battery dies, how will they catch up to the rest of her school?
